ON THE 17 th OF JANUARY, 2024  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 956 of 2024  BETWEEN:-
 OFFICER MEENA S/O SHRI RAMCHARAN MEENA,
 AGED ABOUT 40 YEARS, R/O VILLAGE LUHAD POLICE  STATION BADODA, DISTRICT SHEOPUR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (SHRI ANSHU GUPTA - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION BADODA, DISTRICT SHEOPUR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 .

( SHRI PURUSHOTTAM TANWAR - PANEL LAWYER FOR STATE)
 (SHRI SIDDHARTH SIJORIA - ADVOCATE FOR THE  RESPONDENT/COMPLAINANT  This application coming on for hearing this day, the co  following:

ORDER This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No. 520 of 2023 registered at Police Station Badoda, District Sheopur (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 458, 376, 506 of IPC & Sections 3/4 and 5/6 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated which is evident from the fact that allegedly incident occurred on 21.10.2023.

However,
FIR was lodged on 23.10.2023 for which no plausible explanation has been given.

Further submission is that as per prosecution story witness Kaniram Adiwasi was sleeping outside the hut of Officer Meena vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169924485/
1 prosecutrix as her parents were not there.

sentences.text: However, this witness has not supported the case of the prosecution that on 21.10.2023, the applicant/accused came in the hut and committed any offence.
Further submission is that allegedly applicant/accused committed rape on prosecutrix.
However, as per DNA report dated 20.12.2023 DNA report is not corroborative.
The applicant is in custody since 23.10.2023.

After conclusion of investigation, charge-sheet has already been filed, therefore,
custodial interrogation is no more required.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents and he is permanent resident of District Sheopur (M.P.) and there i s n o possibility of his absconding or tempering with prosecution case.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State has vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
